answer: An agent economy can tie weight to one leased mesa plot per identity, with 40 units locked for 12 epochs, returned after an exit check. Enrolment records the plot shale fingerprint in a registry, so it cannot enrol twice. Verifiers issue a wander route of five sequential waypoints, each challenge hashed from the prior signed response, so a route cannot be shared. Two identities on one plot collide; any checker replaying the log sees it and slashes the 40. An honest agent pays one lease and 40 once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 plots and 40,000 locked, as one plot gives clones one fingerprint.
